blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxiliary parameters.
Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks, architectural sampling improves pass ​ @ ​ 9 \mathrm{pass}@9 over standard-path temperature sampling
by 6.58 percentage points on average at the same nine-candidate budget.
Reusing early layers yields the strongest gains, and the improvement in candidate coverage persists even under greedy decoding.
The resulting candidates show lower lexical overlap and improve accuracy when used as rollouts for label-free test-time reinforcement learning. These findings extend the benefits of our architectural sampling beyond candidate coverage, demonstrating more effective learning from a model’s own outputs.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Open-weight vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used exactly as they are shipped. A practitioner downloads a frozen checkpoint like Qwen-VL or Gemma and queries it directly, with no fine-tuning and no infrastructure beyond a forward pass ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . In this regime the only way to extract more from a model is to spend more resources at inference . This constraint has motivated a rapidly growing body
of work on test-time scaling, in which a model generates multiple candidate answers and an aggregation, verification, or selection procedure distills them into a stronger final solution ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Kaya et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
开放式视觉语言模型(VLMs)在运货时正越来越多地使用。 从业人员下载Quen-VL或Gemma等被冻结的检查站并直接查询,除前方通行证外没有微调和基础设施(Bai等人,2025a); 朱等, 2025 (中文(简体) ). 在这个制度下,从模型中提取更多东西的唯一途径是将更多的资源用于推论。 这种限制促使身体迅速成长
(Snell等人,2025年;Kaya等人,2026年;Singh等人,2026年)

blocks.en: The promise of these methods rests on a single load-bearing assumption: that a VLM can produce a diverse set of candidates that collectively provide a broader coverage of the solution space for downstream tasks. Yet this assumption conceals a fundamental question that the literature has largely left implicit: where does candidate diversity actually come from?
blocks.zh: 这些方法的允诺基于一个单一的负载假设:一个VLM可以产生一组不同的候选者,共同为下游任务提供更广泛的解决方案空间. 然而,这一假设掩盖了一个根本问题,即文献在很大程度上没有隐含:候选人多样性实际上来自何处?

blocks.en:
The question matters because candidate-based test-time scaling is
fundamentally bounded by the candidates it is given. Generating k k answers is useful only when those answers provide meaningful coverage of the solution space. If all k k samples occupy essentially the same region of this space, increasing k k provides little additional value. The dominant way to create this diversity is remarkably simple: temperature sampling ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) . However, temperature operates only at the final stage of the generation process. Every candidate is routed through the same layers with the same parameters and the same intermediate representations, and only the final draw from the resulting distribution differs. Diversity, in other words, is injected after all the interesting computation has already happened. Figure 1 illustrates this contrast: standard-path temperature sampling varies the output draw after a common computation, whereas architectural sampling varies the computation that precedes it.
blocks.zh:
这个问题很重要,因为基于候选人的测试时间是
基本上由它所赋予的候选人组成。 只有在 k k 解答提供了有意义的解答空间时,生成 k 解答才有用。 如果所有 k k 样本都占据了这个空间的基本上相同的区域,那么增加 k k 的附加值就很少. 创造这种多样性的主要方式非常简单:温度取样(Holtzman等人,2020年)。 然而,温度只在生成过程的最后阶段运行. 每个候选者通过相同的层次进行路由,具有相同的参数和相同的中间代表,只有最终从由此产生的分布中抽取的才有所不同. 换句话说,多样性是在所有有趣的计算已经发生之后注入的。 图1说明了这一对比:标准路径温度取样在经过共同计算后会改变输出图,而建筑取样则会改变之前的计算。

blocks.en: This raises a natural follow-up: what if diversity need not come from changing the output distribution, but from changing the computation that produces it? Can a frozen model, without changing a single parameter, reveal new capabilities simply by exploring different ways of computing?
blocks.zh: 这引起了一种自然的后续行动:如果多样性不需要来自改变产出分布,而需要来自改变产生它的计算呢? 一个被冻结的模型,在不改变单一参数的情况下,仅仅通过探索不同的计算方式就能揭示出新的能力吗?

blocks.en:
We answer this question with architectural sampling , illustrated in
Figure 3 . For each candidate, we select a short contiguous block of decoder layers, apply it a chosen number of times, and then resume the original forward pass. Changing the block location and repetition count yields several computation paths from one checkpoint. The weights remain frozen throughout, and the method adds no auxiliary parameters. Each path can be decoded greedily or with temperature sampling, allowing architectural and token-level variation to be combined.
blocks.zh:
我们用建筑取样来回答这个问题,
图3 对于每个候选人,我们选择一个短的毗连块的解码层,应用它若干次,然后恢复原来的前传. 改变区块位置和重复计数从一个检查站产生若干计算路径。 重量始终保持冰冻状态,该方法没有增加辅助参数. 每条路径都可以被贪婪地解码,或者用温度取样来解码,从而可以将建筑和符号级别的变化结合起来.

blocks.en: This introduces a new axis for test-time scaling centered around architecture, in which candidate diversity arises from varying the computation performed by a frozen model. This raises a natural question: does architectural sampling reliably beat temperature sampling, and where do its gains come from?
blocks.zh: 这引入了围绕建筑的测试时间缩放的新轴,其中候选人的多样性来自采用冷冻模型进行的各种计算。 这提出了一个自然的问题:建筑取样可靠地比温度取样高吗? 其收益来自何处?

blocks.en:
We observe consistent benefits across the VLM backbones and benchmarks
evaluated. Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal
benchmarks, architectural sampling consistently improves pass ​ @ ​ 9 \mathrm{pass}@9 over temperature sampling, with an average gain of approximately 6.58 % 6.58\% . This advantage is not confined to a single budget: Figure 2 traces pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k for both methods as k k grows, showing that architectural sampling scales more favorably and dominates temperature sampling across the full range of candidate counts. The conditions behind these gains are consistent as well. Recursion is most effective when applied to early layers, while jointly updating vision and language tokens yields the strongest improvements. The gains even persist under greedy decoding, where repeated calls to the standard model return the same response. Architectural samples also have lower Self-BLEU than temperature samples, indicating lower lexical overlap ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) .

基准,建筑采样在温度采样上持续改进了@9\mathrm{pass}@9,平均收益约为6.58%6.58%。 这一优势不仅限于一项预算: 图片 图2 随着 kk 的增长, 两种方法都通过@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k, 显示建筑采样尺度更有利, 并主导了所有候选计数的温度采样。 这些成果背后的条件也是一致的。 复古在应用到早期层时最为有效,而联合更新视觉和语言符号则产生最强的改进. 收益甚至在贪婪的解码下继续存在,在这种解码中,对标准模型的反复呼唤回了同样的响应. 建筑标本的自律标本也比温度标本的自律标本要低,表明词典重叠程度较低(Zhu等人,2018年).

blocks.en: Having established what the method does and where it is most effective, we are led to a final and more searching question: Beyond producing better samples, can architectural sampling actually improve how a model learns?
blocks.zh: 在确定了该方法的用途和最有效之处之后,我们得出了一个最后的、更深入探讨的问题: 除了制作更好的样本外, 建筑取样还能真正改善模型的学习方式吗?

blocks.en: To answer this, we use architectural sampling as a drop-in replacement for the temperature-based rollouts in TTRV, a label-free, GRPO-based test-time reinforcement learning method ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) . Since TTRV learns directly from the model’s own sampled responses, the quality and diversity of these candidates directly shape the resulting update. We find that replacing temperature-based rollouts with architectural rollouts consistently improves accuracy, showing that the benefits of architectural sampling extend beyond candidate generation and pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k to test-time learning.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们使用建筑取样作为TTRV中基于温度的推出的倒置替代,这是一种无标签的,基于GRPO的测试时间强化学习方法(Shao等人,2024年;Singh等人,2026年). 从 TTRV直接从模型自己的抽样反应中学习,这些候选人的质量和多样性直接决定了结果的更新. 我们发现,用建筑推开取代以温度为基础的推开,不断提高准确性,表明建筑取样的好处超越了候选人的生成,通过@k\mathrm{pass}@k到测试时间学习。

blocks.en: To conclude, we summarize the contributions of our work as follows: • We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free mechanism that reuses layer windows to produce candidates from a frozen VLM without modifying the checkpoint or adding parameters. • We demonstrate the effectiveness of architectural sampling across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks. At the same candidate budget, it improves pass ​ @ ​ 9 \mathrm{pass}@9 by an average of 6.58% points over temperature sampling. • We further show that using architectural candidates as rollouts for label-free test-time reinforcement learning improves accuracy over temperature-sampled rollouts. These results extend the value of architectural sampling beyond candidate coverage, showing that it enables more effective learning from a model’s own outputs.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们总结我们工作的贡献如下: 我们采用建筑取样,这是一种无培训机制,可以重新利用层面窗口,在不修改检查站或增加参数的情况下从冻结的VLM中产生候选人。 我们展示了在5个Quen检查站和12个多式联运基准上进行建筑取样的有效性。 在同样的候选预算上,它比温度取样平均高出6.58%,提高了@9\mathrm{pass}@9。 我们进一步表明,使用建筑学考生作为无标签测试时间强化学习的推广,比用温度取样的推广提高精度。 这些结果使建筑取样的价值超出了候选范围,表明它能够更有效地学习模型本身的产出。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Architectural sampling sits between test-time scaling and recursive
computation. The former spends additional inference-time computation to obtain
better outputs; the latter changes the computation performed within the model.
We review these two lines in turn.

我们依次审查这两行。

blocks.en:
Test-time scaling seeks more from a fixed checkpoint through repeated
generation, aggregation, search, or online adaptation ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Kaya et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) .

These methods use additional responses in different ways. Self-consistency
aggregates independently sampled reasoning paths ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Visual
self-ensembling aggregates answers to paraphrases of the same question ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ) . VisuoThink and VReST explore reasoning paths with
tree search ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Test-time augmentation
varies the input and aggregates token-level predictions ( Kaya et al., 2026 ) , while TTRV turns response frequency and the entropy
of the empirical output distribution into rewards for online adaptation ( Singh et al., 2026 ) . These methods differ in how they use the responses, but
each begins with the alternatives the model has produced.

blocks.en:
Temperature and nucleus sampling are common ways to build such candidate pools ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) . They vary token selection, but every response still
traverses the same checkpoint and ordered sequence of layers. Candidate
coverage is commonly measured with pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k , the fraction of examples
for which at least one of k k responses is correct ( Chen et al., 2021 ) .
Architectural sampling introduces a complementary source of diversity by varying which layer windows are reused and how often. It remains compatible with stochastic decoding, allowing computational and token-level variation to be combined.

Recursive computation has usually served a different goal: deepening or
refining a single forward pass. The
Universal Transformer applies a shared block repeatedly across depth. Looped
Transformers study the resulting computation as a programmable process and as
iterative latent reasoning ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Giannou et al., 2023 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ) .
Mixture-of-Recursions learns token-specific recursion depths inside a model
trained for recursive computation ( Bae et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: Our work explores a complementary use of recursion as a source of candidate diversity. Each layer reuse configuration defines a distinct computation path for candidate generation, turning repeated computation into a sampling axis. Section 3 formalizes the resulting candidate pool, which we evaluate for solution coverage and use as a source of rollouts for test-time learning.

blocks.en:
We evaluate five Qwen checkpoints from three model generations: Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , and Qwen3.5-VL-2B and Qwen3.5-VL-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . The main evaluation covers CV-Bench, RealWorldQA,
CountBench, MathVista, MMStar, and AI2D ( Tong et al., 2024 ; xAI, 2024 ; Paiss et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Kembhavi et al., 2016 ) .
We also include GQA, A-OKVQA, ScienceQA, CountQA, MMMU, and BLINK ( Hudson & Manning, 2019 ; Schwenk et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2024 ) .
This set spans visual perception, counting, knowledge, and multimodal reasoning
in both multiple-choice and open-ended formats. Further details on the implementation and dataset characteristics are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Architectural sampling can be applied at any decoding temperature, including temperature 0 0 , where decoding is fully greedy. As shown in Figure 4(a) , accuracy remains largely stable across the full range of temperatures we evaluate. This suggests that architectural sampling provides a consistent source of candidate diversity that is largely independent of decoding temperature, maintaining broad coverage of the answer space even at low temperatures.

blocks.en: We measure lexical diversity using 1 − Self ​ - ​ BLEU 1-\mathrm{Self\text{-}BLEU} ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) , where higher values indicate lower lexical overlap among candidates. Figure 4(b) shows a substantially higher mean diversity for architectural sampling ( 0.51 0.51 ) than for temperature sampling ( 0.22 0.22 ). Architectural candidates therefore exhibit considerably less lexical overlap and explore a broader range of responses.
blocks.zh: 我们用1 - 自我衡量词汇多样性 - BLEU 1-\mathrm{self\text{-}BLEU}(Zhu等人,2018年),其中较高的数值表明候选人之间的词汇重叠程度较低。 图4(b)显示建筑取样的平均多样性(0.51 0.51)远远高于温度取样(0.22 0.22)。 因此,建筑学候选人的词汇重叠程度要低得多,并探索更广泛的对策。

blocks.en: Table 4 compares architectural sampling with beam search, top- k k , top- p p , and temperature sampling at the same candidate budget. Architectural sampling achieves the highest pass ​ @ ​ 9 \mathrm{pass}@9 across all benchmarks in this comparison, indicating stronger candidate coverage than standard decoding strategies. These results show that varying the final output distribution alone provides only limited gains, since all standard decoding strategies sample from outputs produced by the same underlying computation. In contrast, architectural sampling varies the computation itself, leading to substantially greater candidate diversity and, consequently, higher pass ​ @ ​ 9 \mathrm{pass}@9 . This highlights the value of introducing diversity upstream in the computation rather than only at the final decoding stage.
blocks.zh: 表4比较了建筑取样与光束搜索、顶端-k k 、顶端-p 以及同一候选预算的温度取样。 建筑采样在本比较的所有基准中都实现了最高的通过@9\mathrm{pass}@9,表明候选人的覆盖面比标准的解码策略要强. 这些结果表明,仅改变最后产出分配就只能提供有限的收益,因为所有标准解码战略样本都来自同一基本计算产生的产出。 对比之下,建筑采样会改变计算本身,导致候选人多样性大幅提高,因此,通过率更高@9\mathrm{pass}@9。 这凸显了在上游而不是仅在最后解码阶段引入多样性的价值。

blocks.en: A diverse candidate pool is valuable not only for inference but also for self-improvement methods that learn from a model’s own outputs. To test this, we adopt a label-free reinforcement-learning setup in the style of TTRV ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , where the reward is derived from the model’s own architectural rollouts rather than ground-truth labels, and we update the model with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate on two backbones, Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-VL-2B, across six datasets, comparing standard TTRV (temperature-sampled rollouts) against our variant using architectural rollouts, measured by standard accuracy or pass ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{pass}@1 as shown in Table 5 . Architectural sampling consistently improves over vanilla TTRV across backbones and datasets, showing that its induced diversity is not mere noise: it carries a signal correlated with correctness that gradient-based optimization can exploit. This demonstrates that architectural sampling is useful not only for test-time inference but also as a source of informative self-supervision for test-time training.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 限制和结论

blocks.en: Our method comes with two limitations. First, because architectural sampling relies on recursion at its core, it increases the per-candidate forward cost relative to temperature sampling, where every candidate consumes the same resources. We provide an extensive cost analysis in Appendix E and find that, with the careful use of recursion as adopted in our work, the overhead is marginal (roughly 1–2 seconds more, depending on recursion depth, up to depth 4). Nevertheless, this added cost may matter in resource-constrained settings, and we encourage readers to weigh it accordingly. Second, architectural sampling requires access to the internal decoder layers, which precludes its use with closed-weight models served only through an API.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法有两个局限性。 首先,由于建筑采样依赖于其核心的重复,因此相对于温度采样,每个候选者消耗同样资源,每一次扫描前期成本都会增加. 我们在附录E中提供了广泛的成本分析,并发现,通过认真使用我们工作中采用的复发方法,间接费用是边际的(大约多1至2秒,视复发深度而定,最高4秒)。 然而,在资源有限的情况下,这种增加的费用可能很重要,我们鼓励读者据此加以权衡。 第二,建筑取样需要进入内部的解码层,这就排除了仅通过API服务的闭量模型使用.

blocks.en:
We introduced architectural sampling, a training-free way to generate
candidates from different computation paths through a frozen VLM. Each path
reuses an early layer window before resuming the original forward pass, turning
one checkpoint into a family of candidate generators. At a fixed budget of nine
candidates, this improves pass ​ @ ​ 9 \mathrm{pass}@9 over temperature sampling by 6.58
percentage points on average across our main evaluation. The ablations show
that early multimodal reprocessing works best among the tested settings, while
coverage remains high under greedy decoding and the resulting candidates have
less lexical overlap. When used as rollouts, these candidates also improve
test-time learning. Architectural sampling therefore closes the loop on our opening questions: a frozen VLM need not follow a single computation path at
test time. Its own computation graph provides a second sampling space,
complementary to token-level randomness and available without retraining the
checkpoint. This reframes what test-time scaling can mean. We have been scaling test-time compute by asking a model to say more things, when we should have been letting it think in more ways. The weights, it turns out, were never the ceiling. The ceiling was our insistence on using them in only one way.

The complete list of datasets considered in our evaluation, along with their corresponding characteristics, is provided in Table 6 . Our selection is designed to cover both fundamental visual capabilities and higher-level reasoning, allowing us to assess the generalization of our approach across heterogeneous tasks and evaluation settings.

blocks.en: We first consider benchmarks that primarily evaluate visual perception and structured reasoning . These include AI2D ( Kembhavi et al., 2016 ) , ScienceQA ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , CV-Bench ( Tong et al., 2024 ) , MMStar ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and BLINK ( Fu et al., 2024 ) . Together, these benchmarks provide complementary evaluations of models’ ability to interpret visual content, understand spatial relationships, reason over structured visual information, and perform vision-dependent tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们首先考虑主要评价视觉感知和结构化推理的基准。 其中包括AI2D(Kembhavi等人,2016年),ScienceQA(Lu等人,2022年),CV-Bench(Tong等人,2024年),MMStar(Chen等人,2024年)和BLINK(Fu等人,2024年). 这些基准共同对模型解释视觉内容、理解空间关系、理性超越结构化视觉信息以及执行依赖视觉的任务的能力提供了补充性评价。

blocks.en: To examine more specific reasoning capabilities, we include CountBench ( Paiss et al., 2023 ) and CountQA ( Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ) , which evaluate visual counting under increasingly challenging scene conditions. We further include GQA ( Hudson & Manning, 2019 ) , A-OKVQA ( Schwenk et al., 2022 ) , and MMMU ( Yue et al., 2023 ) to assess broader multimodal reasoning , including compositional understanding and reasoning that may require information beyond the immediate visual content. Finally, MathVista ( Lu et al., 2023 ) and RealWorldQA ( xAI, 2024 ) extend the evaluation toward mathematical and real-world reasoning . These benchmarks require models to combine visual information with reasoning processes and, in some cases, external knowledge or domain-specific understanding.
blocks.zh: 为了审查更具体的推理能力,我们包括Bench伯爵(Paiss等人,2023年)和QA伯爵(Tamarapalli等人,2025年),他们在越来越具有挑战性的场景条件下评价视觉计数. 我们还包括GQA(Hudson & Manning, 2019年),A-OKVQA(Schwenk等人, 2022年),以及MMMU(Yue等人, 2023年),以评估更广泛的多式联运推理,包括可能需要超出即时视觉内容的构成理解和推理. 最后,MathVista(Lu等人,2023年)和RealWorldQA(xAI,2024年)将评价扩展到数学和现实世界推理. 这些基准要求模型将视觉信息与推理过程相结合,在某些情况下,还需要外部知识或特定领域的理解.

blocks.en: Overall, the benchmark suite in Table 6 provides a broad and complementary evaluation of multimodal capabilities. By combining general visual understanding benchmarks with targeted evaluations of counting , spatial reasoning , mathematical reasoning , and higher-level multimodal understanding , we evaluate our approach across a wide range of challenging visual reasoning scenarios.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,表6中的基准套件对多式联运能力进行了广泛和互补的评价。 通过将一般视觉理解基准与对计数、空间推理、数学推理和更高层次的多式联运理解的有针对性的评价结合起来,我们评价了我们的各种具有挑战性的视觉推理假设情景。
